00483.label: Nivolumab every 2 weeks
additional_support: Minimal emetic risk; no routine antiemetic prophylaxis or premedication. Prescribe rescue/support individually.
Immune alert card and immediate symptom reporting.

Blood count, kidney/liver tests and glucose before every 2-week cycle; thyroid once a month; cortisol if clinically indicated. Review cancer progression before cycle 8. Continue immune-toxicity monitoring for at least 5 months after the last dose.
Effective contraception during treatment and at least 5 months afterwards; specialist breastfeeding discussion.
Current NCIS medical-oncology guidance does not create a routine cytotoxic prescription for minimal-risk nivolumab monotherapy.

Hormone replacement alone does not always mean nivolumab must stop. Your team checks symptoms and recovery and reviews any medicines that suppress the immune system before deciding whether treatment can continue or restart.

A previous permanent-stop decision remains part of the nivolumab treatment history even if symptoms improve; do not restart without specialist review. Keep the agreed steroid, other immunosuppression and hormone plan.

00455.label: Pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks
additional_support: No routine antiemetic prophylaxis or routine infusion premedication is usually required. Use an individual/local symptom-relief prescription if needed.
Carry the immunotherapy alert card and report possible immune symptoms promptly during and after treatment.
Blood count, renal/liver profile and glucose before each cycle; thyroid every 3–6 weeks, cortisol if clinically indicated.
Effective contraception during treatment and at least 4 months after the last dose.

If treatment is paused because of an immune side effect, your team checks recovery and any steroid or hormone plan before deciding whether it can restart. Do not change steroids or restart treatment yourself.

A previous permanent-stop decision remains part of the pembrolizumab treatment history even if symptoms improve; do not restart without specialist review. Keep the agreed steroid, other immunosuppression and hormone plan.
